freeze_boundary: Draft only. Materializes exactly the MR-001 rejection rules (duplicate key, invalid semver, missing permission/cost/data policy), the MR-004 deny-by-default activation rule, and the MR-005 lifecycle states. The registry resolution algorithm (MR-002), the dependency range grammar and resolver (MR-003), the drain/shutdown protocol timing (MR-005) and the admin diagnostic view model (MR-006) are NOT inferred here. Every rule in this schema carries an x-source naming the task it comes from, and each states whether it is sourced verbatim or is a declared inference.
untestable_by_fixture: MR-002 requires duplicate-capability resolution to be deterministic and MR-003 requires circular dependencies to be blocked. Both are properties of a registry across MULTIPLE manifests; a single-document fixture cannot demonstrate either. They need a registry harness before freeze and are not claimed as materialized.
